answer: Because the whisper partition is computed from the delta history, the fable audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 8 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
